nom: SOME BY MI Clear Spot Patch

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the patches extract visible gunk from a pimple and finds them more effective than higher-end brands; another calls them the best pimple patches tried and better than most competitors; however one reviewer reports no improvement on breakouts and says some pimples got worse.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers describe the patches as effective and gentle on active blemishes, with good adhesion and absorption of gunk, but one reviewer specifically notes certain pimples worsened while using them.

aspects.libelle: Thin and barely visible on skin

extraits.texte: Love that the patches are barely noticeable, but they did not do anything for my breakouts. In fact, some pimples got worse. I wanted to like them, but i did not :(.

At first, I was a little concerned about the price since it's relatively cheaper compared to higher-end brands, but I'd say it performs better than most. The patch itself pulls out the gunk, and you can actually see it being extracted. I also appreciate the patch blending in with my skin.
They adhere well and have better absorption than competitors.

reserve: The reviews are too few and too short to say anything about skin type, aging, dehydration, redness, barrier, or oiliness.
